summary: Host tools own worktree lifecycle and checkout inspection. Concord provides no worktree inspection or locator service and retains no worktree metadata; mandatory verified snapshots precede table removal. Ordinary directory-resolved Project authority, session identity, no-write preparation, handoffs and artifacts remain. Product-state cleanup needs no ownership proof. Self-hosting still requires proven readiness and an accepted authority change.
title: Host tools own worktree isolation; capability does not establish self-host readiness
